Metadata.title: Clara
Metadata.description: Clara — AI-native Agentic Accounting OS for Malaysian accounting firms.

FirmHome.heading: Firm home
FirmHome.body: P1 foundation scaffold — the firm-altitude workspace (Needs-you inbox, client register, firm activity, admin) is built in P3/P4. See docs/plan/active/mohe-grill-rulings-2026-08-27.md Q3.

NeedsYou.heading: Needs you
NeedsYou.body: P2 shell — the cross-client Needs-you inbox is built in P3. See docs/plan/active/mohe-grill-rulings-2026-08-27.md Q3.

ClientsRegister.heading: Clients
ClientsRegister.body: P2 shell — the client register (every client the firm serves) is built in P3. See docs/plan/active/mohe-grill-rulings-2026-08-27.md Q3.

FirmActivity.heading: Activity
FirmActivity.body: P2 shell — the firm activity/receipts feed is built in P3. See docs/plan/active/mohe-grill-rulings-2026-08-27.md Q3.

Admin.heading: Admin
Admin.body: P2 shell — users, capabilities and the metering rollup are built in P4. See docs/plan/active/mohe-grill-rulings-2026-08-27.md Q3.

ClientWorkspace.heading: Client workspace
ClientWorkspace.body: P1 foundation scaffold — the client workspace tabs (journals, documents, bank, close, reports, registers, knowledge) are built in P3. See docs/plan/active/mohe-grill-rulings-2026-08-27.md Q3.

CommandPalette.title: Command palette
CommandPalette.description: Go to a page, ask Clara, or dispatch a run.

do.heading: Do
do.disabledLabel: Dispatch a run — wires up in P3

ClientJournals.heading: Journals
ClientJournals.body: P2 shell — drafts, the review queue, manual JE compose and posted-entry reversal are built in P3. See docs/plan/active/mohe-grill-rulings-2026-08-27.md Q3.

ClientDocuments.heading: Documents
ClientDocuments.body: P2 shell — upload, OCR, the evidence viewer, correction and filing are built in P3. See docs/plan/active/mohe-grill-rulings-2026-08-27.md Q3.

ClientBank.heading: Bank
ClientBank.body: P2 shell — accounts, statements, matching and reconciliation are built in P3. See docs/plan/active/mohe-grill-rulings-2026-08-27.md Q3.

ClientClose.heading: Close
ClientClose.body: Pick a fiscal year to view its close plan — gates, doors, and the receipt/segregation record. Every figure is read live from the DB; “Clara proposes close” is not built yet (no close_proposals carrier exists).

picker.empty: No fiscal years opened yet for this client.

plan.mismatch: Close plan unavailable — the read did not match the current selection.
plan.selectPrompt: Select a fiscal year above to view its close plan.

begin.title: Begin close — {label}
begin.description: clara.begin_close — opens a close run and evaluates every gate. Needs the close_and_attest capability.

finalize.title: Finalize close
finalize.description: clara.finalize_close re-evaluates every gate in-transaction. A solo firm, or a year with no distinct human preparer, needs an explicit self-attestation — leave it blank otherwise.

abandon.title: Abandon this close run
abandon.description: clara.abandon_close reopens the fiscal year for editing without a receipt. Requires a reason.
abandon.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this close run being abandoned?

reopen.title: Reopen this closed fiscal year
reopen.description: clara.reopen_fiscal_year mirrors the closing entry as a prior-period adjustment. Needs the reopen capability, a reason (10+ characters), and a correction target. A CLR05 refusal (no_eligible_human / attestation_required / distinct_checker / self_attestation) names exactly who may act — try again with an attestation if it asks for one.
reopen.attestationLabel: Attestation (only if a refusal named it)

gates.heading: Close gates
gates.empty: No gate measurements yet — begin the close to evaluate them.

attest.title: Attest this gate exception
attest.description: clara.attest_close_exception — the existing audited attest door (0056). One click records one attestation, bound to the gate's current measurement.

receipt.heading: Close receipt & segregation
receipt.absent: No close receipt yet for this fiscal year.

proposal.heading: Clara proposes close
proposal.body: Not built yet — no clara.close_proposals carrier and no wake_propose_close verb exist in the live catalog. When they ship, this panel reads the existing proposal (never invents one), and attest_close_exception's own p_from_proposal argument links an attestation back to it.

ClientReports.heading: Reports
ClientReports.body: Statutory close reports (sealed, archived) and the analysis sandbox (watermarked, requested through Clara) — every figure and every custody fact is read live from the DB.

statutory.heading: Statutory close reports
statutory.subheading: The signed-original archive (0127) — sealed, never watermarked.
statutory.notDeployed: The reporting engine is not deployed in this environment yet.
statutory.empty: No report artifacts yet for this client.
statutory.noDownload: No byte-download door exists yet — copy the storage key and retrieve the file through ops tooling. A signed-URL download route is a named follow-up, not built in this pass.

issue.title: Issue this pack for approval
issue.description: clara.approve_report_for_issue — the one human act that closes the pre_sign chain. Names the sealed hash shown below, never recomputed.

archive.title: Archive the signed original
archive.description: clara.archive_signed_original — the wet-signed pack's own identity, bound to the pre-sign hash it answers.

retrieve.none: No signed original archived yet for this run.

receipts.heading: Agent receipts
receipts.empty: No agent-act receipts yet for this client.

sandbox.heading: Analysis sandbox
sandbox.subheading: Watermarked, never sealed (0132) — structurally unreachable by the seal chain.
sandbox.requestNotice: There is no human "request export" door — the mint/request verbs are granted to Clara's agent lane only. Ask Clara, in the rail, to build a sandbox view or request an export.
sandbox.empty: No sandbox exports yet touching this client.

register.title: Register an export recipient
register.description: clara.register_export_recipient — admin only. Firm-member recipients only in this form (an external recipient's covered-clients form is a named follow-up).

freeform.heading: Freeform reads
freeform.subheading: The audited "ask the books" read log (0131) — a history, not a query box.
freeform.runNotice: There is no human "run a freeform read" door — wake_freeform_read is Clara's agent lane. This is a read-only history of what Clara has read.
freeform.empty: No freeform reads yet touching this client.

ClientRegisters.heading: Registers
ClientRegisters.body: P2 shell — AR/AP aging, fixed assets, adjustments, staff advances and accounts are built in P3. See docs/plan/active/mohe-grill-rulings-2026-08-27.md Q3.

ClientKnowledge.heading: Knowledge
ClientKnowledge.body: P2 shell — the knowledge/data-library surface is built in P3. See docs/plan/active/mohe-grill-rulings-2026-08-27.md Q3.
